classification: external event parameters fixed before numerical target digitization; not externally preregistered
primary_family: local-geometry scaled DB04 with finite water-heat depletion
rules: No Rochemelon-fitted coefficient is an independent comparator on this event.
No station-specific new gain and no refitting to external bed targets.
Shared geometry and forcing assumptions across thermal families.
Missing numerical Q, depth, width or spatial alignment is a gate, not a silent default.
Lake inlet temperature needs explicit downstream finite heat depletion before it predicts local bed loss.
All imposed observed forcings imply retrospective hindcast, not advance prediction.
All declared engineering scenarios retained; no winning scenario selected by target error.
No inference of general consistent field superiority from one additional event.
comparison_criterion: Lower MAE against every declared comparator at each matched cross-section, with common accepted intervals; report input/measurement sensitivity separately. No target accuracy threshold chosen after scores.
